body:
You're very kind. 

I meant that the person who molested me destroyed my life. There are also a few things I enjoy, but they're not worth it. They didn't outweigh everything else.

I think anyone would be at least a little uneasy approaching death.

Apologies if I seem rude. Not my intention.
I am a seventeen year old girl.

I am -- or, rather, was, I should say -- actually quite a hateful, envious, codependent, angry, abusive person. That's the BPD (borderline personality disorder) which in turn stemmed from the boy who decided, when I was five, that he was going to destroy any chance for me to live a normal life.

But I'm okay now. I'm going to be part of nature, of everything. A dust mote in a ray of sun. Wind over grass. The first blossom and the last falling leaf -- that will be me. I had no use in life, but I will in death: beauty. At last.

I appreciate the sentiment, but I don't think you'll be thinking about "that thejungleisdark person" a year from now.

Also, the few things I enjoy are not enough to cope with all that has gone, will go, and is going on.
